title: Dashboard Import Action Permission Consistency

items.action: authorize creation of a new import from the Dashboard quick actions
discover the mandatory fair after entering the general new-import wizard

migration.reason: Existing fair_crm.imports.create and fair_crm.fairs.read permissions are reused.

backend.reason: Existing import authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contracts change; Dashboard visibility is aligned with the existing import-create and fair-list authorization boundaries.

tenant_isolation.reason: No backend query or organization-scoping behavior changes.

audit.reason: No mutation or audit behavior changes.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

notes: Dashboard Import Baslat navigates to the general new-import wizard, where selecting a fair is mandatory before upload. The quick action therefore fails closed unless both fair_crm.imports.create and fair_crm.fairs.read are granted. The upload mutation itself remains imports.create-only, fair-scoped import entry remains create-only, and Dashboard access itself is unchanged.
